title: Implement tile rendering and camera system for Pixel Runner
description: Replace the placeholder Game Started text in the render() function of index.html with actual tile-based level rendering. Draw each tile type (GRASS, STONE, SPIKE, ICE, BREAKABLE, PLATFORM, COIN, GEM, powerups, EXIT) using the TILE_COLORS map with pixel-art style rectangles. Implement a camera object that follows the player with lerp smoothing using CONFIG.CAMERA_LERP. Offset all rendering by camera position. Render moving platforms. Add a dark gradient background with parallax scrolling star field. Draw the player sprite using makePlayerSprite() and drawSprite(). The existing level generation (generateLevel), tile constants, and sprite functions are already in index.html - just wire them into the render loop.
